verdict.rationale: React's docs and community evidence confirm its reconciliation engine automatically updates the DOM to match new component state without manual diffing (react-docs-3), and hands-on community discussion praises React's custom DOM diffing/change-management abstraction as efficient and non-blocking (react-comm-5, react-comm-6). This is React's core value proposition of declarative UI backed by an internal reconciler rather than a literal build-time compiler, but it fully satisfies the developer need to avoid manual DOM diffing.
